name: Alertbox
description: Creates alert boxes (via block_content) to display information banners across the site.
project_description:
Creates a alertbox to display a message across the website.

 This module came from the need to create alerts across the website (Homepage and Inner pages) in a way that could be manageable by Content Managers without giving them access to the "Block management" page.

 Back to top 

 Features 
 - New content type "Alertbox", used as Nodeblock (D7)

- Visibility field per alertbox node to set the display on Home and/or Secondary pages.

- Administration page to select the default theme region to assign the alertboxes.

- Option to show alerts in a modal (sub module alertbox_modal, require ctools module(D7))

- Option to dismiss the alertbox and don't see the message again.

 Back to top 

 Dependencies (D7 only): 
 - Nodeblock

- Ctools (alertbox_modal)
